select tcs.id, tcs.name from sg_tccon_tcsite_b tcs left join sg_dic_tcstationtype tcst on tcst.code = tcs.tcsite_type left join SG_DIC_VOLTAGETYPE vol on vol.code = tcs.voltage_class left join sg_tccon_tcgrid_b tc on tc.id = tcs.par_grid left join sg_dic_tcdispatchlevel level on level.code = tcs.dsp_level where case when tcst.name = '变电站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', vol.name || tc.name || '变', '%' ) when tcst.name = '换流站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', vol.name || tc.name || '站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '营业网点' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '营业厅', '%' ) and tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '营业网点', '%' ) and tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '服务站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '火电厂' or tcst.name = '垃圾电厂' or tcst.name = '热电厂' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '电厂', '%' ) when tcst.name = '水电站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '水电站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '核电站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '核电站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '抽水蓄能电站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '抽水蓄能电站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '储能电站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '储能电站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '光伏电站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '光伏电站', '%' ) when tcst.name = '风电场' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '风电场', '%' ) when tcst.name = '开闭所' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', vol.name || tc.name || '开闭所', '%' ) when tcst.name = '环网柜' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', vol.name || tc.name || '环网柜', '%' ) when tcst.name = '独立通信站' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name, '%' ) when tcst.name = '中心站' then ( case when level.name = '总部' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '国调', '%' ) when level.name = '分部' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '网调', '%' ) when level.name = '省级' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '省调', '%' ) when level.name = '地县' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '地调', '%' ) or tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '县调', '%' ) when level.name = '备调' then tcs.name not like concat( '%', tc.name || '备调', '%' ) end ) end

SELECT rule.id ruleId, vrule.id vruleId, vrule.meta_mode_id modelId, rule.rule_name ruleName, rule.english_name englishName, model.table_name tableName, model1.table_name rtableName, tech.column_name columnName, tech.column_name_cn columnNameCn, tech.column_type columnType, tech1.column_name rcolumnName, tech1.column_name_cn rcolumnNameCn, tech1.column_type rcolumnType, vrule.modification_suggestions modificationSuggestions, vrule.rule_description ruleDescription, vrule.select_type selectType, vrule.symbol symbol, vrule.param param, vrule.customized_sql customizedSql FROM t_quality_verification_rules vrule LEFT JOIN t_quality_basic_rules rule ON vrule.rule_id = CONCAT( rule.id ) LEFT JOIN t_meta_model model ON CONCAT( model.id ) = vrule.meta_mode_id LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_tech tech ON CONCAT( tech.id ) = vrule.meta_model_column_id LEFT JOIN t_meta_model model1 ON CONCAT( model1.id ) = vrule.rel_meta_mode_id LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_tech tech1 ON CONCAT( tech1.id ) = vrule.rel_id_meta_model_column_id where rule.id is not null and vrule.id = #{ruleId}
